verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a tax-services platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring background actions such as scheduled payments. However, the evidence documents no user-configurable automation. EFTPS, Direct Pay and Payment Plan appear only as bare titles with no scheduling or recurring-run details. MeF and IRIS A2A are credentialed system-to-system intake channels, which are developer building blocks rather than automations the product runs for the user. Interactive flows like the EIN assistant are session-bound and keep business hours.
